sunlit.caption: sun-warmed pavement or wall, real FLIR thermal frame (no label: a bright patch away from every labelled object)

generator.caption: running truck engine and machinery (stand-in for a generator)

space_heater.caption: warm car front (stand-in for a space heater)

hot_pipe.caption: lamp post or light housing (stand-in for a hot pipe)

server_rack.caption: boxy warm bus panel (stand-in for a server rack)

laptop.caption: small warm panel (stand-in for a laptop)

source: Teledyne FLIR ADAS v2 thermal, images_thermal_val + video_thermal_test (never trained on); frames used by the runtime crops, unsure pairs and the held-out test set excluded
note: dog and sunlit are real counterparts; the other five are stand-ins (warmest crops of the closest labelled class), named as such in each caption
